projects.title: ERP systems
projects.subtitle: One operation. A connected view.
projects.summary: Bring the moving parts of your business into one working system.
projects.challenge: Purchasing, stock and orders often depend on separate records. The work slows down when teams cannot see the same information.
projects.direction: Start with the workflow. Connect the records people use and bring exceptions, approvals and next actions into focus.
projects.detail: This interface study explores an exception-led operations workspace. The final modules, permissions and integrations are scoped to your organisation.
projects.image_note: Website-specific interface concept with demo data. This is an illustration of the solution area, not a screenshot of a live customer system.

projects.outcome: A tailored solution scope, agreed against the actual business requirements.

projects.meta_description: Connect inventory, purchasing, orders and approvals with ERP software from Nu Labs. Explore an illustrative operations interface and development scope.
projects.overview: Nu Labs develops enterprise resource planning (ERP) systems that connect operational records and workflows. We scope the modules, permissions and integrations around how your organisation buys, manages stock and fulfils orders.

projects.title: CRM systems
projects.subtitle: Every relationship. A clear next step.
projects.summary: Give your team a clearer way to manage relationships and follow-through.
projects.challenge: Customer context can disappear between conversations, spreadsheets and individual inboxes.
projects.direction: Bring the relationship, recent activity and next action into a shared workspace. Keep the follow-up visible.
projects.detail: The illustrative sales board keeps the next action visible on each opportunity. Pipeline stages and workflows are shaped around how your team actually sells and supports customers.
projects.image_note: Website-specific interface concept with demo data. This is an illustration of the solution area, not a screenshot of a live customer system.
projects.claim_status: Service and in-house solution capability confirmed by founder; depicted UI newly authored for this website.

projects.overview: Nu Labs develops customer relationship management (CRM) software for shared customer records, sales activity and follow-up. We work with your team to define the stages, responsibilities and connections each relationship needs.
projects.meta_description: Build clearer customer workflows with Nu Labs CRM development: contacts, sales pipelines, activity history and integrations shaped around your team.

projects.title: Point of sale
projects.subtitle: A smoother path from basket to sale.
projects.summary: Connect the checkout experience to the operation behind the counter.
projects.challenge: A busy counter needs clear product selection and transaction context, while the business needs dependable records.
projects.direction: Design around the person making the sale: quick item discovery, an understandable basket and a deliberate checkout sequence.
projects.detail: This concept uses a compact catalogue and a readable current-sale panel. Hardware, payment providers and offline requirements are evaluated during discovery; the screen shown does not process payments.
projects.image_note: Website-specific interface concept with demo data. This is an illustration of the solution area, not a screenshot of a live customer system.

projects.overview: Nu Labs develops point-of-sale (POS) applications for the work at the counter and the records behind it. We define product, basket, stock and reporting requirements together, then assess the relevant device and payment integrations.

projects.title: Native mobile apps
projects.subtitle: Useful software, wherever work happens.
projects.summary: Build for the way people use a phone, not just a smaller browser window.
projects.challenge: Work continues away from a desk. A useful mobile experience must respect the device, the context and the person holding it.
projects.direction: Keep the next action obvious. Design for touch, platform conventions and the real conditions in which the app will be used.
projects.detail: The field-work concept demonstrates a focused daily schedule and job handoff. Offline behaviour, notifications and device capabilities are agreed per project.
projects.image_note: Website-specific interface concept with demo data. This is an illustration of the solution area, not a screenshot of a live customer system.

projects.service_name: Native Android and iOS application development
projects.overview: Nu Labs designs and develops native Android and iOS applications. We plan the core journeys, data connections and platform requirements around the person using the app, whether they are at a desk, on site or moving between tasks.

projects.title: AI solutions
projects.subtitle: Useful intelligence, inside the workflow.
projects.summary: Put AI to work on specific business tasks with clear boundaries.
projects.challenge: A fluent answer is not enough. Businesses need the right information, useful actions and a path to human review.
projects.direction: Define the task, connect the appropriate knowledge and make uncertainty visible. Keep people involved where judgement matters.
projects.detail: This illustrative assistant shows a sourced answer and a defined handoff. Model choice, data access and evaluation criteria are established around the intended use, rather than promising perfect answers.

projects.service_name: AI chatbot and business automation development
projects.overview: Nu Labs builds AI chatbots, knowledge assistants and workflow automation for defined business tasks. We plan which information the system can use, how answers are evaluated and when a person needs to review or take over.

projects.title: Cybersecurity software
projects.subtitle: See the signal. Know the next step.
projects.summary: Make security information easier to investigate and act on.
projects.challenge: An alert only becomes useful when the person reviewing it can understand the context, priority and available next action.
projects.direction: Bring the queue, affected context and investigation steps together. Make status and ownership clear without hiding uncertainty.
projects.detail: The interface study uses simulated incidents to demonstrate a triage workflow. It does not claim a detection rate, certification, compliance status or guaranteed protection.

faq.question: Do you build custom software as well as in-house solutions?
faq.answer: Yes. We develop in-house software solutions and build custom applications. Discovery establishes whether an existing solution, a tailored integration or a new build best fits the requirement.

faq.question: Can you build for both Android and iOS?
faq.answer: Yes. We develop native Android and iOS applications. The platform scope, integrations and release requirements are agreed at the start of the project.

faq.question: Are the interfaces on this site live product screenshots?
faq.answer: They are website-specific interface concepts with demo data, illustrating the types of solutions we develop. A project discussion can establish the relevant solution, available demonstration and scope.

faq.question: What should we include in an initial brief?
faq.answer: Tell us what your business does, what is difficult today, who will use the software and which systems it needs to connect to. A timeline and budget range also help define a practical starting point.
